'''Warralokk''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] located in the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]]. During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Tarkov]] and his son [[Jaccoba]] discovered the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invasion force. They warned the cities of the archipelago, but the cities, including [[Grunnrurr/Legends|Grunnrurr]], soon fell to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] invaders.

==Behind the scenes==
Warralokk was first mentioned in the now-defunct [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Tarkov, a character from the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated tv series.
